about.heading: About
about.journeyText: Mariana graduated in Psychology in 2011 and specialized in Neuropsychology in 2014 at CEPSIC, Hospital das Clínicas da FMUSP. Between 2013 and 2015, she was a volunteer intern at PANI (Pediatric Neuropsychological Assessment Project) and in the epilepsy and speech-language outpatient clinics at HC-FMUSP.
about.neuropsychologyText: Her interest in neuropsychology was present from the start of her studies. Today, Mariana works in neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation across all ages — from children to older adults — with a growing focus on aging and geriatric neuropsychology.
about.clinicalText: Mariana's clinical practice takes place at Clínica Jundiaí and Consultório Itu, both under Instituto Nexium, providing neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation across the lifespan.
